steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the pipeline; canvas is displayed
Step 2 — Enable the "Attachments" toggle in MODULES (left panel, TOOLS section); toggle flips to checked with zero network requests
Step 3 — Click "State" button; the STATE panel opens
Step 4 — STATE panel shows three immutable variables: input, messages, input_attachments — each with a checked toggle
Step 5 — Verify 'input_attachments' was auto-added when Attachments was enabled: no delete button (immutable)
Step 6 — While Attachments is enabled, verify in Yaml view that the state section includes 'input_attachments' (type: list)
Step 7 — Disable the "Attachments" toggle in MODULES; toggle flips to unchecked with zero network requests
Step 8 — Verify 'input_attachments' is removed from the STATE panel
Step 9 — Verify in Yaml view that the state section does not include input_attachments
Step 10 — No console errors were introduced at any step
